title: Deja Vu Again & Again
author: Ron Buchanan
problems: Row 3 "robins form a long wave in the center - balance the wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 3 is not on a side line to dance in.
Row 6 "larks form a long wave in the center - balance the wave" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2 is not on a side line to dance in.
Row 7 "partners meltdown swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 8 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 9 "neighbors swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
choices: A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
